parole.significato: action (something done so as to accomplish a purpose)
parole.testo: From Old Church Slavonic дѣиствиѥ (děistvije), probably via Russian де́йствие (déjstvije). By surface analysis, де́я (déja, “to act”) + -ствие (-stvie).
Inherited from Old Church Slavonic [Term?]. Derived from Russian [Term?].

parole.significato: idle claim/talk/promise (claim, talk, promise without content), verbiage
parole.testo: Borrowed from Old Church Slavonic соуѥсловьѥ (sujeslovĭje), possibly mediated via Russian суесло́вие (sujeslóvije), calque of Ancient Greek ματαιολογία (mataiología). Equivalent to суе- (sue-, “futile”) + сло́во (slóvo, “word, speech”) + -ие (-ie).
